column1: # What every input must accept and refuse, one example per row, shared by the
# page and the daemon. scripts/web-check.mjs runs each row through the page's
# validator (web/validate.js) and scripts/smoke.sh posts it to the running
# daemon: the two must agree with the expectation, so neither layer can change a
# rule without the other (and this table) changing with it.
#   key      a config key, written as NAME=value through /api/config
#   password /api/password: the NAME column is the user, the value the password
#   sshkey   /api/sshkeys add: the value is the key line
#   me       /api/omci?cmd=me&me=  (a class id or table name)
# value    form-urlencoded, as it travels: %20 for a space, %2B for a plus
# The last column is for the reader. Rows run in order: an ssh key accepted
# once is a duplicate the next time, which is the point of the row after it.
